key_provisions_or_claims: Cybernetic avatars need operator authentication, CA authentication and CA notarisation to be trustworthy.
Continuous authentication is needed to link operator and avatar.
Unidentified fabricated avatars (UFO avatars) risk enabling crime, so legislation analogous to Japan's mobile phone misuse law is needed.
A new field of 'AI, Robot, and Avatar Law' and an ELSI research platform are proposed.
Certification of tangible CAs via inspection-like procedures and of intangible CAs via anti-fake technology, referencing EU AI and machinery rules.
annotation.summary_en: Article by Fumio Shimpo on authentication infrastructure for cybernetic avatars (robots and virtual avatars). It proposes operator authentication, CA authentication and notarisation, and calls for a new field of 'AI, Robot, and Avatar Law' with an ELSI platform, plus certification and legislation against unidentified avatars.
